The plaque has an oval shape with a grid pattern and contains inscriptions that read "IDRANTE" at the top and "COMUNE DI FIRENZE" at the bottom, indicating it is related to the city of Florence (Firenze). The number "40" is also visible on the left side of the plaque. The photo appears to have been taken outdoors, as suggested by the texture of the concrete and the lighting. There are no people
